entities.name: Acquisition of MIB and SIB1
entities.description: Procedure for UE to acquire Master Information Block (MIB) and System Information Block 1 (SIB1) based on UE state and conditions.

entities.name: Master Information Block
entities.description: Broadcast system information block containing essential cell access parameters.

entities.name: System Information Block 1
entities.description: Broadcast system information block containing cell access information and scheduling of other SIBs.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not connected to the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE maintains connection context but is not actively communicating.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection to the network.

entities.name: T311
entities.description: Timer running during connection re-establishment procedure.

entities.name: MIB acquisition required conditions
entities.description: Conditions requiring MIB acquisition: UE in RRC_IDLE, RRC_INACTIVE, or RRC_CONNECTED with T311 running.

entities.name: SIB1 acquisition required conditions
entities.description: Multiple conditions requiring SIB1 acquisition including UE states, system information changes, and missing valid SIB versions.

entities.name: SSB subcarrier offset indicates SIB1 transmission
entities.description: Condition where SSB subcarrier offset parameter indicates whether SIB1 is transmitted in the cell.

entities.name: Apply BCCH configuration
entities.description: UE applies specified BCCH configuration as defined in specification.

entities.name: SIB1 acquisition failure handling
entities.description: Actions performed when UE is unable to acquire SIB1.

relations.description: Procedure requires UE to apply BCCH configuration
MIB acquisition requires specific UE states or timer conditions
When MIB acquisition conditions are met, UE acquires MIB
SIB1 acquisition requires specific UE states and conditions
SIB1 acquisition is guarded by SSB subcarrier offset condition
When SSB indicates SIB1 transmission and acquisition is required, UE acquires SIB1
When SSB indicates SIB1 is not scheduled, UE performs acquisition failure actions
RRC_CONNECTED state with T311 running triggers MIB acquisition
